title: Layer 3 round 5 major security: default-ignorable UNASSIGNED code points (U+E0000, U+2065, U+FFF0-FFF8, unassigned tag block) pass the Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp category filter and reach the terminal — the category proxy covers assigned invisibles only

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 52f94321: is_terminal_unsafe now also strips UNASSIGNED default-ignorable code points in the reserved ranges (U+2065, U+FFF0-FFF8, U+E0000-E0FFF), gated on GeneralCategory::Unassigned so the assigned invisibles stay category-caught and the variation selectors (U+E0100-E01EF, Mn) in the same block survive. U+E0000 no longer reaches the terminal. Unit-pinned both ways: the unassigned ignorables strip, a variation selector survives. This closes the last edge of the char class — the category proxy plus the reserved-range gate cover assigned AND unassigned invisibles.
